description: This file defines a FastAPI-based MCP server implementation with multiple API routes and helper functions for managing MCP tools, prompts, resources, and their communication with external MCP servers. It includes route definitions, utilities for server filtering, permissions, and resource handling, as well as initializing and managing session managers. It supports both local tools and external managed MCP server interactions, and includes conditional imports for optional MCP module support.
